Elaine —

Thanks — we can absolutely provide a completed questionnaire and a short statement for your legal team. I attached a draft Q&A that addresses hosted, dedicated, and private deployment differences and regional availability. Highlights up front:

- Hosted API (Redwood-hosted): primary storage region is configurable (US or EU currently). APAC physical hosting for the public Hosted API is scheduled via our Singapore edge in Q4 2026; until then APAC customers can use our closest region (ap-southeast fallback) with contractual protections.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): physical hosts can be provisioned in a customer-selected cloud region (AWS: ap-southeast-2, ap-southeast-1, eu-west-1, us-east-1) subject to capacity commitments. Data residency at rest and for logs is configurable to remain in-region.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full control — customer-managed network and local hosting options (including Singapore and Sydney) supported.

I attached: Redwood_Data_Residency_Q&A_20260315.pdf (completed questionnaire).

Two ask items for clarity before we finalize the signable statement:
1) For Globex, do you need the statement to reference a specific APAC city (Singapore vs Sydney) or is a general "APAC region (Singapore and Australia)" acceptable?
2) Are there specific legal phrasing requirements from your counsel ("must not transfer data outside Singapore without consent", etc.)? If you send the clause, we'll respond with redlines.

We are looping Marissa (account lead) and Ben (security) to ensure the questionnaire and statement map to our controls.

Karthik / Marissa —

I reviewed the draft Q&A and added a few technical clarifications (short form below). I'll include these notes in the final PDF. Elaine — pasting the highlights here to make review quicker.

- Encryption: Data at rest is AES-256 encrypted. For Hosted and Dedicated we support customer-supplied KMS keys (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) for Dedicated and Private; Hosted supports customer-managed keys via our KMS integration for higher tiers.
- Logs & audit trails: For Dedicated and Private deployments logs (audit, request traces, token usage) can be configured to stay in the customer region and/or forwarded to a customer-managed SIEM. For Hosted, logs required for platform operations are stored in-region when possible; aggregated telemetry for platform reliability may be processed outside region after anonymization unless contractually restricted.
- Cross-region replication: Not enabled by default. For Hosted we offer optional cross-region backups for disaster recovery; these are by explicit config and can be disabled for compliance-sensitive customers.
- Support access & incident response: Support engineers can be granted time-limited access to specific instances for debugging; for Private deployments this access is subject to customer network controls (bastion/VPN) and an audited session.

Related links: SOC2 summary (https://redwood-inference.com/trust/soc2-summary). I'll attach a short SOC2 extract.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
